bbl_source_scope.purpose: supplement current-season training finals missing from both the frozen historical archive and retained official finals
bbl_source_scope.processing: Jina Reader renders BetExplorer season results into Markdown. The parser verifies its stated source and season, a shared event link, ordered teams, a valid date, positive non-tied scores, and carries the AET flag.
bbl_source_scope.independent_schedule: Official BBL calendar binds date in Berlin, ordered teams, kickoff and calendar UID. A single matched secondary result is required to supplement a due calendar fixture.
bbl_source_scope.independent_scores: Only a retained official final with one matching secondary row triggers comparison of the home and away scores. Discrepancies are recorded and the official final is kept. Frozen archive fixture keys suppress supplements without a new score comparison. A calendar-only match cannot independently attest the score, overtime, or finality.
bbl_source_scope.hashes: Hashes describe parsed calendar and score lists. Complete measures age and coverage, and a recorded score discrepancy on an already covered match need not make it false.
